notes: Backs the design doc's corrected MAD==0 rule (docs/solution-design/lossy-json-compression.md §4B item 2): 'retries' is 0 for 14 of 15 items, so the per-path MAD collapses to exactly 0 -- the earlier (wrong) draft would have scored this as 'no signal' and let seq 9 drop under an aggressive ratio. The corrected rule scores any value that differs from a MAD==0 field's shared value as a strong discrete outlier. Exercises the `lossy-tokenfold` compressor entry (real Rust `--lossy` CLI path), not the generic line-segmented Python selectors. Filler rows carry per-row varied prose deliberately: a `$tf_ref` marker's 64-hex-char hash tokenizes far worse than natural language, so rows shorter than the marker that would replace them are auto-kept as unprunable and the fixture would exercise no lossy selection at all (a round-5 external review found exactly that).
